events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Bitter Realization

options.text: Nothing can possibly fix what is broken.
Whatever the path is to inner peace, it cannot be remaining here.

events.text: [character] has proved beyond the grasp of any vengeance. Years have passed, and you begin to wonder if, after all this time, any peace in your heart is even possible.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: These Things Happen

options.text: Just the way of things, I suppose.

events.text: You really did intend to get to that surprise for [character]. It just turned out to be a little more difficult than you thought. You don't really see him so much these days, and that seems to suit you both fine.
